subject: Quarter Compass: Chartering OKRs, Metrics Playbook, and Signoff Logistics
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter Compass: Chartering OKRs, Metrics Playbook, and Signoff Logistics

Hi team,

I'm starting this thread to align leadership on the quarter launch: the chartered objectives, the measurement playbook, and a lightweight signoff flow. The goal is to get a locked OKR set + companion metrics playbook by EOD Tuesday so CS/Product can begin rollout planning.

Key asks:
- Marcus: please review the charter language for serving/runtime goals (attached draft).
- Grace: can you validate the customer-facing metrics that will be surfaced in QBRs?
- Laura: confirm the approvals list we should route to (Legal/Finance/Revenue Ops).

I've attached a living measurement playbook (Q4_compass_measurement_playbook_v1.xlsx) and the quarter charter draft (quarter_charter_draft.pdf). I put a first-pass signoff checklist in the sheet "Signoff-v1".

Constraints we should remember: cost-per-inference targets remain a priority; any OKR that materially increases reserved capacity must include a finance impact note.

Let's keep comments inline in the drive doc for traceability. If you can sign off (or say what blocks you) by 5 pm PT on Tuesday 8/24, we can route the final packet to Legal by Wednesday morning.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4_compass_measurement_playbook_v1.xlsx (workbook), quarter_charter_draft.pdf (PDF)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Compass: Chartering OKRs, Metrics Playbook, and Signoff Logistics

Evelyn — quick pass from my side.

Summary of edits I added to the charter PDF and workbook:
- Tightened objective wording under "Serving Reliability" to emphasize 99.9% p99 latency under target load rather than p95. (Rationale: aligns to SLA ask from two enterprise customers.)
- Added a proposed sub-OKR for "Model Rollout Readiness" that maps to our canary funnel metrics — see sheet 'Rollout OKRs'.
- Flagged two items that need a finance note: burst-capacity buffer and a potential capacity pilot in EU.

Open questions:
1) Do we want delivery-level metric owners named in the playbook, or keep owners at objective level? I'm leaning toward delivery-level owners for traceability.
2) Is there appetite to include a small quality guardrail metric for embeddings (cosine similarity on eval set)? If so, I'll add a suggested eval and owner.

I can hop on a 20-min sync tomorrow if that's helpful.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachment: signoff_checklist.csv (stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Compass: Chartering OKRs, Metrics Playbook, and Signoff Logistics

Thanks Marcus — helpful edits. A couple of notes from my side: 

- Customer-facing metrics: the playbook currently lists "avg latency" and "99th latency"; we should normalize naming to "p50/p95/p99" and add a short definition for each so Sales/CS are consistent in QBR decks. I've added a comment in the Drive playbook with the wording.
- For QBRs I want a single slide metric that shows "cost per 1k tokens" vs. target; please surface that in the top-level dashboard and mark it as a required visual.
- On the embeddings quality guardrail: yes, please include the cosine similarity check and link to the evaluation notebook. Marcus, can you nominate an owner?

I can sign off on the charter language subject to the small name normalization above.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Compass: Chartering OKRs, Metrics Playbook, and Signoff Logistics

Evelyn — routing and approvals: 

- Legal: Amy Zhou (legal@redwood.ai) — standard 48-72 hour review if there are no policy changes.
- Finance: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai) — needs the finance impact line items; if any reserved capacity changes are proposed, Ben needs a cost delta and a justification.
- Revenue Ops: Marcus or I to confirm dashboard wiring, then Revenue Ops will publish the QBR template.

I can be primary for the final signoff packet so it goes through the right gates. If you want a single sign-off email thread, let's do it after we incorporate Marcus and Grace's edits.

Laura Bennett
VP, People & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sharon Lee <sharon.lee@acme.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@partners.io>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Compass: Chartering OKRs, Metrics Playbook, and Signoff Logistics

Thanks all — I've folded Marcus's and Grace's edits into the drive doc. High level: 
- Objective slate locked except for the "EU pilot" sub-OKR Marcus flagged (we need finance approval).
- Playbook: normalized p50/p95/p99 naming and added the cost-per-1k-tokens visual.
- I've named delivery-level owners in the 'Rollout OKRs' sheet per Marcus's suggestion.

Next steps: 
1) Marcus to add the embeddings eval recommended metric (owner + notebook link) by EOD today.
2) Ben (Finance) to confirm cost delta for EU pilot by end of day Thursday 8/26. (Laura will route.)
3) I will assemble the final signoff packet and send a single approval request to Legal/Finance on Friday 8/27.

Sharon — appreciate the heads-up on your QBR cadence. We'll include the cost visual on the dashboard you requested; Samir, feel free to flag any partner-facing items.

Evelyn

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter Compass: Chartering OKRs, Metrics Playbook, and Signoff Logistics

Looping in here since I own the finance review: quick note — I ran a back-of-envelope on the EU pilot buffer. Estimated incremental monthly cost: $18k-$26k depending on utilization posture. If the pilot is capped to a single week of burst capacity per month, mid-case ~ $9k incremental monthly.

Decision for leadership: if the pilot requires persistent reserved capacity, that's a material commit. If it's strictly burst, we can run it as a controlled pilot and measure before committing. I'll put a short one-pager in the drive called 'EU_pilot_finance_note'.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance
Redwood Inference
